The '''Thul research camp''' was a [[House of Thul|House Thul]] installation located in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Among the personnel stationed there were [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sorchka]], [[Miles]], [[Rehmar Thul]] and [[Yudin Thul]].
